model_dependence: The 80% threshold is met by the stated weak-prior primary model, not by every plausible prior. Normal SD 3pp and 5pp sensitivity gives 72.5% and 78.7%; stronger shrinkage below 80% is disclosed.
scope: Probability of stronger play in the fixed adaptive trap benchmark. General human-ladder improvement probability is not identifiable from these tests.
frequentist_gate: Original gate remains failed. Owner explicitly adopted a different decision criterion after outcomes.
comparison_reason: EarlyPerish meets 80% and has highest posterior expected win probability; RetainPerish alone does not meet 80%.
shipping_scope: EarlyPerish and its RetainPerish base, appearance cache refresh, default constructor wiring, focused tests. Excludes conditional full-loadout and whole-set sampling experiments.
